name: web-design-system-hero-with-gradient-outlined-cta-and-inbox-app-preview
title: Hero 'Ruixen: Design Systems for the Visionary Web' with a black and a violet-outlined button, an email app preview and a logo row
whatItIs: A white page with a bold navy centred headline, a grey subline, a black Start Building button and a white Request a demo button with a violet-to-teal gradient outline, a large inbox UI preview (folders, mail list with tags, message pane) fading into white at the bottom, and a row of company logos beneath.
whatItMeans: Clean and credible; a gradient outline makes the secondary CTA feel special without weight.
techniques: Outline a secondary button in a gradient.
Fade a product preview into the page.

vocabulary.definition: A button border made from a colour gradient.
A screenshot dissolving into the background.
A filled and an outlined action.
